questions.question: The Gandhara School of Art was influenced by ______ art.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Greek and Roman__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gandhara School** was based on **Greek-Roman** norms encapsulating foreign techniques and an alien spirit.
 
• It is also known as the **Graeco-Buddhist** School of art. 
 
• The foreign influence is evident from the **sculptures of Buddha** in which bear **resemblance to the Greek sculptures.**
 
• **Grey sandstone** (Blue-grey Mica schist to be precise) is used in Gandhara School of Art. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Bamyan Buddha of Afghanistan** was the example of the Gandhara School. 
 
• **Marble** was **NOT used** in Gandhara art. 
 
• **Terracotta **was used **rarely**.
 
• **Bimaran Casket** has yielded the **earliest specimen** of the **Gandhara Art.**

questions.question: Taxonomic studies consider a group of individual organisms with fundamental similarities as a/an ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Species__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taxonomic** studies consider a group of **individual organisms** with **fundamental similarities as a/an species.**
 
• **Taxonomy **is the process of **naming and classifying** **things **such as **animals and plants** into groups within a larger system, according to their similarities and differences.
 
• Taxonomic studies consider a group of **individual organisms with fundamental similarities** as species because each genus has only a **specific epithet** representing **different organisms**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genealogy **is the study of the **family**.
 
• There are **eight distinct taxonomic** categories: Domain, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, and Species.
 
• With each **step down in classification**, organisms are **split into more and more specific groups**.

questions.question: With reference to human physiology, which of the following lobes is mainly concerned with visual information?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Occipital__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The occipital lobe is the **visual processing area** of the brain.
 
• It is associated with **visuospatial processing**, **distance and depth perception**, **colour determination**, **object and face recognition**, and **memory formation**. 
 
• Each side of your brain contains **four lobes**.
 
• The **frontal** **lobe **is important for cognitive functions and control of **voluntary movement or activity.**
 
• The **parietal lobe processes** information about **temperature, taste, touch**, and movement, while the occipital lobe is primarily responsible for vision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The temporal lobes** are also believed to play an important role in processing affect/emotions, language, and certain aspects of visual perception.
 
• **The frontal lobe **is the part of the brain that controls important cognitive skills in humans, such as emotional expression, problem-solving, memory, language, judgment, and sexual behaviours.
 
• **The parietal lobe **is one of the major lobes in the brain, roughly located at the upper back area in the skull.

questions.question: Part XVII of the Constitution of India deals with the official language in Articles 343 to ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__351__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Part XVII** is a compilation of laws pertaining to the constitution of India as a country and the union of states that it is made of.
 
• This part of the constitution consists of Articles on **Official Language**.
 
• **Chapter 1 **covers Articles 343 and 344 and settles for two official languages of India - Hindi, written in Devanagari script, and English.
 
• **Chapter 2 **covers articles 345–347 and writes that the regions of India are eligible to use any of the official languages of India for official purposes.
 
• **Chapter 3** covers articles 348 and 349 and writes that the official language of the Supreme Court of India, the High Courts of India.
 
• **Chapter 4 **covers articles 350, 350A, 350B, and 351.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct with regard to Consumer Price Index?

options.text: It measures the average change in the sale price of goods and services either as they leave the place of production or as they enter the place of production.
It is used to monitor changes in the cost of living over time.
It is used to monitor the cost of the goods and services bought by producers and firms.
It reflects the price of all the goods and services produced domestically.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It is used to monitor changes in the cost of living over time.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Consumer Price Index (CPI) **is a measure that **examines the weighted average of prices of a basket** of consumer goods and services, such as **transportation, food, and medical care**.
 
• It is calculated by taking price changes for each item in the **predetermined basket of goods and averaging them.**
 
• The current Consumer Price Index of India is **156.60.**
 
• A CPI is a statistical estimate constructed using the prices of a sample of representative items whose prices are **collected periodically**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Consumer Price Index** in India is **published monthly by the Central Statistical Organization (CSO).**
 
• **The Headquarters** of the Central Statistical Organization is in **New Delhi**.
 
• The Central Statistical Organization was established in **1951**.
 
• The government announced that the **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) **will be merged with the **Central Statistics Office** to form the **National Statistical Office (NSO).**

questions.question: In the context of the Banking Sector in India, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: The Indian law legalises the use of Rupee as a medium of exchange.
Livestock may also be a form of collateral.
Credit always pushes the borrower into a situation from which recovery is very painful.
The RBI issues currency on behalf of the Central Government.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Credit always pushes the borrower into a situation from which recovery is very painful**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **debt trap** is a situation when credit pushes the borrower into a situation from which **recovery is very painful**.
 
• Technically, a debt trap is a situation where you're **forced to take fresh loans** to **repay your existing debt obligations.**
 
• **Dept trap is not considered in terms of Banking terms.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Repo rate** - It is the rate at which the central bank of a country (Reserve Bank of India in case of India) lends money to commercial banks in the event of any shortfall of funds.
 
• **Reverse Repo rate** - It is the rate at which the Reserve Bank of India borrows funds from the commercial banks in the country.

questions.question: The term 'Tripitakas' in Buddhism mean three:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Baskets__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tripiṭaka **is a Sanskrit word meaning **Three Baskets**.
 
• It is the traditional term used by **Buddhist traditions** to describe their **various canons of scriptures**.
 
• The expression **Three Baskets** originally referred to three receptacles containing the scrolls on which the **Buddhist scriptures **were originally preserved. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__**Some important terms used in Buddhism are:**__

 
• **Buddha**. - `Buddha` means `an enlightened person.
 
• **Dhamma**. - The truth about what life is really life.
 
• **Sangha**. - The community of Buddhists.

questions.question: Which of the following musicians belonged to the state of Assam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Bhupen Hazarika__**.

__
 
• **Bhupen Hazarika** (8 September 1926 – 5 November 2011) was an Indian **playback singer**, lyricist, musician, poet, and filmmaker from Assam, widely known as **Xudha kontho**.

• **Prabodh Chandra Dey** (1 May 1919 − 24 October 2013), known by his stage name Manna Dey, was an internationally acclaimed Indian playback singer, music director, musician, and Indian classical vocalist.

questions.question: The Shore Temple, which is a UNESCO Heritage Site, is located in the state of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Tamil Nadu__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Shore Temple** is so named because it overlooks the shore of the **Bay of Bengal.**
 
• It is located near **Chennai in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It is a structural temple, **built with blocks** of granite, dating back to the **8th century AD.**
 
• **At the time of its creation**, the site was a busy port during the reign of **Narasimhavarman II of the Pallava dynasty.**
